换两者位置）。如果其中一名特工在当前转折点
执行过冲锋，后撤或转移行动，且另一名特工就
绪，那么另一名特工在这个转折点中不能执行上
述任意行动。
这名特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行此
行动。
守护之盾 1AP
灵能。选择这名特工 6" 内且可见的一名己方虚
空创痕海盗特工。直到这名特工下一次激活
前，这名特工残废前或这名特工再次执行了这个
行动前（以首先达成的条件为准），对那名特工
造成普通伤害的第一枚攻击骰将被忽略。
这名特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行此
行动。
cards.text_en:

VOIDSCARRED WAY SEEKER
2 7" 4+ 8
WARP FOLD 1AP
PSYCHIC. Select two friendly CORSAIR
VOIDSCARRED operatives visible to and within 5" of this
operative. Remove them both from the killzone and set them
back up in each other’s previous locations (in other words,
swap their positions). If one of them performed the Charge,
Fall Back or Reposition action during this turning point
and the other is ready, the other cannot perform any of those
actions in its activation during this turning point.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative.
WARDING SHIELD 1AP
PSYCHIC. Select one friendly CORSAIR
VOIDSCARRED operative visible to and within 6" of this
operative. Until the start of this operative’s next activation,
until it’s incapacitated or until it performs this action
again (whichever comes first), the first time an attack dice
inflicts Normal Dmg on that friendly operative, ignore that
inflicted damage.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative.

• 神经破坏枪；动力武器

cards.text_en:
• STARSTORM DUELLIST
• WARRIOR with one of the following options:
○ Shuriken pistol; power weapon
○ Shuriken rifle; fists
• WAY SEEKER
Other than WARRIOR operatives, your kill team
can only include each operative on this list once.
Your kill team cannot include both a blaster and
a wraithcannon.

cards.text:
虚空创痕海盗
阵营规则
步枪
尽管并非所有灵族放逐者都走上了战士道途，但他
们都精通于对步枪的运用。
当一名己方虚空创痕海盗特工在尚未执行冲锋，
后撤或转移行动的激活中使用星镖步枪或游侠长
步枪执行射击时，那个武器获得“精准 1”武器规
则。请注意，这名特工在射击后执行的行动并不受
限制。
cards.text_en:
CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
FACTION RULE
RIFLES
Whilst not all Aeldari outcasts have walked the Path of
the Warrior, all are skilled in the use of rifles.
Whenever a friendly CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
operative is shooting with a shuriken rifle or
ranger long rifle during an activation in which
it hasn’t performed the Charge, Fall Back or
Reposition action, that weapon has the Accurate
1 weapon rule. Note that operative isn’t restricted
from performing those actions after shooting.

cards.text:
虚空创痕海盗
阵营规则
艾达灵族掠袭者
艾达灵族轻盈优雅且灵活的特质使得虚空创痕海盗
们能够用计谋胜过敌人。
每一名己方虚空创痕海盗特工在其激活中可以执行
一次无消耗的冲刺行动。
cards.text_en:
CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
FACTION RULE
AELDARI RAIDERS
Aeldari are lithe, graceful and swift – qualities
the Corsair Voidscarred utilise to outmanoeuvre
their enemies.
Each friendly CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
operative can perform a free Dash action during
their activation.

cards.text:
虚空创痕海盗
标识/指示物指南
博学猎手指示物弗奥楚羁绊指示物
守护之盾指示物领先一步指示物
迷雾场指示物指引符文指示物
cards.text_en:
CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
MARKER/TOKEN GUIDE
Erudite Hunter token Faolchú’s Bond token
Warding Shield token One Step Ahead token
Mistfield token Runes of
Guidance token

cards.text:
虚空创痕海盗
战略计谋
掠夺者
灵族海盗比起荣耀更注重获利，他们会迅速冲向自
己的目标，试图在敌人做出反应前便能夺取战利
品。
至多 D3 名己方虚空创痕海盗特工可以立即以任意
顺序分别执行一次无消耗的冲刺行动。在这个转折
点中，每个执行了上述行动的特工无法在其激活中
执行冲刺行动。该计谋在第一个转折点无法使用。
cards.text_en:
CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
STRATEGY PLOY
PLUNDERERS
Aeldari Corsairs prioritise profit over glory, moving
swiftly towards their objective in the hope of seizing
their prize before the foe can react.
Up to D3 friendly CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
operatives can immediately perform a free Dash
action in an order of your choice. This turning
point, each that does so cannot perform the Dash
action during their activation. You cannot use this
ploy during the first turning point.

cards.text:
虚空创痕海盗
战略计谋
逐利海盗
任何尝试去夺取虚空创痕海盗战利品的愚蠢行为很
快便会面对暴雪般的星镖火力和利刃突刺。
每当一名己方虚空创痕海盗特工进行射击，近战或
反击时，若它或对方敌方特工在流程中正在争夺一
个目标标识或一个己方任务标识时，那名己方特工
的武器获得“平衡”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
STRATEGY PLOY
PIRATICAL PROFITEERS
Any foolish enough to attempt to contest a prize claimed
by the Corsair Voidscarred will soon find themselves
caught in a blizzard of shuriken fire and sword thrusts.
Whenever a friendly CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
operative is shooting, fighting or retaliating, if it or
the enemy operative in that sequence contests an
objective marker or one of your mission markers,
that friendly operative’s weapons have the
Balanced weapon rule.

cards.text:
虚空创痕海盗
战略计谋
机动交战
灵族海盗依靠卓越的速度躲避火力。
每当一名特工对一名己方虚空创痕海盗特工进行射
击时，若那名己方特工在当前转折点执行过进行移
动的行动，您就可以重掷一枚防御骰。
cards.text_en:
CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
STRATEGY PLOY
MOBILE ENGAGEMENT
Aeldari Corsairs rely upon blistering speed to avoid
heavy fire.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED operative that
performed an action in which it moved during
this turning point, you can re-roll one of your
defence dice.

cards.text:
虚空创痕海盗
战略计谋
放逐者
那些走上放逐者道途的存在对孤独早已司空见惯，
他们甚至觉得独自战斗更有意思。
当一名己方虚空创痕海盗特工距离其他己方特工 5"
外时，其武器获得“重击”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
STRATEGY PLOY
OUTCASTS
Those who walk the Path of the Outcast are no strangers
to solitude. Some even fight better alone.
Whenever a friendly CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
operative is more than 5" from other friendly
operatives, its weapons have the Punishing
weapon rule.

cards.text:
虚空创痕海盗
交战计谋
投机战士
若敌人的弱点暴露，虚空创痕海盗便会对其加倍打
击，试图在敌人再次集结前将其消灭。
在一名敌方特工执行后撤行动时使用本交战计谋。
在其移动前，其控制范围内每有一名己方虚空创
痕海盗特工，那名敌方特工便受到一次 2D3 点伤
害。
cards.text_en:
CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
FIREFIGHT PLOY
OPPORTUNISTIC FIGHTERS
Should the foe show weakness, the Corsair Voidscarred
will redouble their attack, seeking to slaughter the
enemy before they can regroup.
Use this firefight ploy when an enemy operative
performs the Fall Back action. Before it moves,
inflict 2D3 damage on that operative for each
friendly CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED operative
within its control range.

cards.text:
虚空创痕海盗
交战计谋
灵巧手活
追求财富驱使着所有的海盗们。这些灵巧的劫
掠者们会在敌人眼皮底下夺取战利品，并在反
击前消失。
在一名己方虚空创痕海盗特工激活中使用此交
战计谋。直到那次激活结束前，哪怕有敌方特工
位于其控制范围内，也不会影响那名己方特工执
行拾取标识或任务行动，并且在通常需要控制标
识才能执行的拾取标识或任务行动中无需控制标
识（这意味着它只需争夺标识）。
cards.text_en:
CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
FIREFIGHT PLOY
LIGHT FINGERS
The pursuit of riches drives all Corsairs. These lithe
raiders may pluck a prize from under the nose of a foe
and disappear before a blow can be landed in return.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly CORSAIR
VOIDSCARRED operative’s activation. Until the
end of that activation, having an enemy operative
within its control range doesn’t prevent that
friendly operative from performing the Pick Up
Marker or mission actions.

cards.text:
虚空创痕海盗
交战计谋
灵活善变
虚空创痕海盗常常在数量和火力上居于劣势，
他们常常会在运用各种佯攻和突袭后消失在
阴影中。
在一名己方虚空创痕海盗特工激活时，在其执
行一次行动之前或之后使用这个交战计谋。在那
次激活中，将那名特工在执行后撤行动时消耗的
行动点数降低 1 点。
cards.text_en:
CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
FIREFIGHT PLOY
CAPRICIOUS FLIGHT
Always outnumbered and often outgunned, the Corsair
Voidscarred utilise feints and trickery to strike before
melting away into shadow.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly CORSAIR
VOIDSCARRED operative’s activation, before or
after it performs an action. During that activation,
that operative can perform the Fall Back action
for 1 less AP.

cards.text:
虚空创痕海盗
交战计谋
高傲冒险家
虚空创痕海盗有着一股无所畏惧的高傲气质，他们
也往往会用高超的武艺佐证这一点。
在一个转折点中您首次激活一名己方虚空创痕海盗
特工时，如果它位于其他己方特工 5" 外，使用
本交战计谋。在这名特工的那次激活中首次执行
的射击或近战行动中，其武器获得“毫不留情”
武器规则。请注意这条计谋不能在一次激活中多
次生效（您不能在同一次激活的射击和近战行动
中同时使用）。
cards.text_en:
CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
FIREFIGHT PLOY
CONTEMPTUOUS ADVENTURER
The Corsair Voidscarred possess a fearless arrogance
that is often justified by their superior skill at arms.
Use this firefight ploy when the first friendly
CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED operative is activated
during the turning point, if it’s more than 5"
from other friendly operatives. The first time that
operative performs either the Shoot or Fight
action during that activation, its weapons have
the Relentless weapon rule. Note this ploy cannot
come into effect more than once per activation
(you cannot use it during both the Shoot and
Fight action in the same activation).

cards.text:
虚空创痕海盗
阵营装备
日耀斗篷
虚空创痕海盗的特工们身披由灵能活性材料织造而
成，能够随着爆炸或温度波动而硬化的斗篷。
当一名特工用带有“爆炸”或“洪流”武器规则的
武器对一名己方虚空创痕海盗特工进行射击时，您
可以重掷一枚己方防御骰。此外，己方虚空创痕海
盗特工不受到“X" 毁灭 X”武器规则（即带有范
围的毁灭规则）效果的影响，除非被作为目标。
cards.text_en:
CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
FACTION EQUIPMENT
DIUTURNAL MANTLES
The cloaks worn by Corsair Voidscarred operatives
are woven from psychoactive material that hardens in
response to explosions and fluctuations in temperature.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED operative, if the
ranged weapon in that sequence has the Blast
or Torrent weapon rule, you can re-roll one of
your defence dice. In addition, friendly CORSAIR
VOIDSCARRED operatives aren’t affected by the
x" Devastating x weapon rule (i.e. Devastating
with a distance) unless they are the target during
that sequence.

cards.text:
虚空创痕海盗
阵营装备
迷雾场
迷雾场发生器会在持有者周围投射出一层浓厚的雾
气，这不仅能遮蔽视野，还能放缓子弹的打击，大
大降低了致命程度。
每个转折点一次。当一名特工对一名 3" 外的己方虚
空创痕海盗特工进行射击时，在掷防御骰步骤开始
时，您可以使用这个规则。若此，直到那个流程结
束前，将“穿刺 X”武器规则的 X 数值降低 1 点，
请注意，这代表“穿刺 1”武器规则将被忽略。
cards.text_en:
CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
FACTION EQUIPMENT
MISTFIELD
A mistfield projects a field of thick moisture around the
bearer that not only obscures their form, but also slows
bullets, reducing their lethality.
Once per turning point, when an operative is
shooting a friendly CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
operative more than 3" from it, at the start of the
Roll Defence Dice step, you can use this rule. If
you do, worsen the x of the Piercing weapon rule
by 1 (if any) until the end of that sequence. Note
that Piercing 1 would therefore be ignored.

cards.text:
虚空创痕海盗
阵营装备
指引符文
虚空创痕海盗能以完美的精度运用亚空间力量，用
预言能力支援远处的盟友。
每个转折点一次，当一名己方虚空创痕海盗寻路者
或虚空创痕海盗织魂者特工执行一次灵能独特行动
时（次元折跃除外），您便可以使用这个规则。若
此，在那个行动结束前，为其距离要求增加 3"。请
注意这对灵能武器没有效果。
cards.text_en:
CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
FACTION EQUIPMENT
RUNES OF GUIDANCE
Corsair psykers wield warp powers with consummate
precision, lending their foresight to distant allies.
Once per turning point, when a friendly CORSAIR
VOIDSCARRED WAY SEEKER or CORSAIR
VOIDSCARRED SOUL WEAVER operative is
performing a PSYCHIC unique action (excluding
Warp Fold), you can use this rule. If you do,
until the end of that action, add 3" to its
distance requirement. Note this has no effect on
PSYCHIC weapons (e.g. the Devastating distance
requirement of lightning strike).

cards.text:
虚空创痕海盗
阵营装备
群星宏图
虚空创痕海盗会利用自己对虚空无与伦比的学识来
胜过敌人。
战略计划。掷一枚 D3：如果结果大于当前转折点
的数值，您获得 1CP，且在战斗中不能再次使用该
战略计划。
cards.text_en:
CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED
FACTION EQUIPMENT
STAR CHARTS
The Corsair Voidscarred utilise their peerless knowledge
of the void to outmanoeuvre their foes.
STRATEGIC GAMBIT. Roll one D3: if the result
is higher than the number of the current
turning point, you gain 1CP and cannot use this
STRATEGIC GAMBIT for the rest of the battle.
